schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Income support for landholding farmer families.

versions.notes: Seeded from the project brief. Re-verify against the official Operational Guidelines before launch.

exclusions.description: A family member paid income tax in the last assessment year.
A family member gets a monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more and was not MTS / Class IV / Group D staff.

chunks.text: Section 2.4 exclusion criteria (project summary, replace with the official text): landholding farmer families with cultivable land are covered, but a family is excluded if any member paid income tax in the last assessment year, or if any member is a pensioner drawing a monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more, except Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV and Group D employees.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly central assistance for older people in BPL households.

versions.notes: Central assistance only; states may add top-ups. Document checklist depends on the state.

requirements.description: A household member is aged 60 or above.
The household is listed as Below Poverty Line (BPL).

benefits.description: Central assistance of Rs 200 per month (age 60-79).
Central assistance of Rs 500 per month (age 80 and above).

source.document: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) guidelines - IGNOAPS

notes: Central assistance only; state top-ups are not included.

sources.title: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) guidelines - IGNOAPS

chunks.text: IGNOAPS (project summary, replace with the official text): persons aged 60 years or above belonging to a Below Poverty Line household receive central assistance of Rs 200 per month between ages 60 and 79 and Rs 500 per month from age 80. States may add their own top-up and set the document checklist.
